From: adjuster@claimsbridge.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 1, 2026
Subject: EPLI panel assignment - please separate the Nguyen matter from the Ochoa matter

ClaimsBridge Administrators is sending a synthetic EPLI carrier assignment thread from Granite Shield EPLI. The current request concerns Talia Nguyen v. Brightline Foods West LLC, not the separate Ochoa wage/hour matter referenced below. Granite Shield EPLI may be payer, ClaimsBridge may be instructing source, Brightline Foods West LLC may be insured and prospective represented client, and Brightline Foods Holdings may be an insured affiliate or joint-employer candidate. The thread asks panel counsel to follow the carrier guideline, but forum and arbitration posture is unknown. Please treat the same adjuster sending multiple matters as matter-linking ambiguity and keep carrier, TPA, insured affiliate, payer, claimant, and represented-client candidates separate.

-----Original Message-----
From: adjuster@claimsbridge.example
To: prior-panel-counsel@synthetic-law.example
Subject: Ochoa wage/hour note

Different synthetic matter: Ochoa alleges meal-period violations against another Brightline location. Do not merge this with the Nguyen discrimination assignment.

-----Original Message-----
From: coverage@granite-shield-epli.example
To: adjuster@claimsbridge.example
Subject: Nguyen EPLI referral

Use the carrier guideline and panel counsel instructions for Granite Shield EPLI. The insured affiliate structure remains under review.
